# apple_stop_app_store_version_experiment (Action)

Stops a running product page optimization experiment. Everyone then sees the original product page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_stop_app_store_version_experiment" "icons" {
  config {
    experiment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `experiment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment.example.id`.
